about_the_game:
Make every second count.

Step into the high-stakes world of emergency medicine with Paramedics!

the first of its kind open-world EMS simulator.
Experience the challenges of real emergency calls, master life-saving techniques, and navigate the unpredictable world of EMS.

Realistic Medical Simulation
Perform accurate and immersive medical procedures that test your skills and decision-making in critical scenarios.

Choose Your Level

Whether you're a beginner learning Basic Life Support (BLS) or an experienced player tackling Advanced Life Support (ALS), Paramedics! adapts to your skill level.

Full-body simulation
with visual, auditory, and text-based scene representations.

Multiplayer co-op

Join forces with friends or fellow EMS enthusiasts in real-time cooperative multiplayer, complete with built-in voice chat for seamless communication.

Dynamic Emergencies & Unpredictable Calls

Respond to high-risk scenarios where patient conditions change dynamically, requiring quick thinking and real-world medical strategies.


Why Play Paramedics! - EMS Simulator?

Passion for Emergency Medicine

If you love medical simulations and emergency response, Paramedics! lets you explore the world of EMS while having fun.

Train Like a Future EMS Professional
Considering a career as an EMT, paramedic, or first responder? Or already in the field? Paramedics! provides an educational and challenging platform to hone your skills.

Early Development, Growing Potential
This is just the beginning! Join us during early development and be part of the journey as Paramedics! expands with new features, scenarios, and gameplay improvements.

content_descriptors.notes: In this EMS simulator you will be exposed to realistic scenes and situations as close as possible to the real world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 +
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 +
  • Processor: x64 architecture
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: First of its kind open world emergency medicine simulator, bringing the option for players around the world to try, learn, and experience what it takes to be in emergency medical services, featuring in-depth and real-life systems, and a responsive human body. You choose what protocols to follow.
supported_languages: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
